title: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground
content: Now there are two: Brazil heads into a runoff after a first round that failed to fully energize voters, setting the stage for a more polarized contest that Washington is watching very closely.

title: Brazil votes, with Lula facing Bolsonaro's son
content: In Brazil, President Lula da Silva faces Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the jailed former president, in a tight race.  If neither wins more than half the votes they'll face each other again on Oct. 25.

title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
content: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," which will coordinate government engagement with artificial intelligence.

title: Cornell president calls gang rape allegations 'deeply disturbing'
content: Cornell president Michael I. Kotlikoff said his university "must do better" in a video statement. "This is a defining moment in Cornell's history," he added.

title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
content: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday.

title: How the Cornell case is affecting women who have experienced sexual assault
content: The rape allegations that have emerged from a Cornell University frat house are leading many women to remember their own experiences — and call for a wider reckoning over sexual violence.

title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
content: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
content: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

title: Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people
content: Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing.

title: Can the Cornell lawsuit force changes that make students safer?
content: Universities have responsibilities when students report sexual assault, even if prosecutors don't bring charges. Attorney Baine Kerr explains how those protections work.
